name: grounded-commits
description: Write and check commit messages, and write pull-request descriptions, in the Grounded Commits format.

interface.shortDescription: Commit messages and pull requests that record what was checked.
interface.longDescription: Writes commit messages in the Grounded Commits format, checks them with the format's reference commit-msg hook, and writes pull-request titles and bodies as short review briefs that leave the record to the commits.
defaultPrompt: Commit these changes as a grounded commit.
Write a grounded description for this pull request.
